reviews.comment: He has probably been one of my favorite professors to date. I really enjoyed the material, and he delivers it in an entertaining way. For tests all the material is on the slides, and if you like text books I found a PDF file online. The only thing I must note you should go to every class, he has a participation quiz every class (worth 5 points each
He's just boring but I mean I guess he's fair.

He is pretty nice overall. Does not really go into detail about anything and just reads from the slides. Each class there's a multiple choice quiz for 5 points, so go to class the quizzes eventually add up to a test grade. Also, there is no hw or practice problems for tests.
reviews.ratingTags: Skip class? You won't pass.--Graded by few things--Test heavy

reviews.comment: Test questions are worded to confuse the students. Professor said average exam grade is 70. Why a good Professor that teaches good will intentionally put hard exams and is taking pride that his average grade is low.

Dr. Criscione is friendly, lectures well, and doesn't go out of his way to trick you. 4 exams (mc), no hw, attendance "quiz" every class (1 mc question, unlimited tries). Straightforward class, no book needed. Go to class for points/lecture (recordings not available), memorize the slides, and you'll do well without trouble.
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Skip class? You won't pass.--EXTRA CREDIT

reviews.comment: There are daily quizzes (very easy and only 1question each) for attendance, but you have unlimited retries, worth 20% of your grade with possible extra credit for going to every lecture. I found myself dozing through the class after the quiz and just studying the slides right before the test. Super sweet guy!
reviews.ratingTags: Accessible outside class--Participation matters--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: 4 Tests, no final, and participation (free) quizzes, including 15 pts of extra credit. The only downside is that there is no book or extra references so attendance is a must since the exams are all based on what he says from the lecture, and since they are online because of COVID the questions are very specific. He is super nice and organized!

Great prof. Tests are based solely on the powerpoints so if you memorize those you're golden. There are easy one question quizzes that help boost your grade as long as you go to class. He usually grades very quickly and best of all there was no final. I wish all my classes were like this one.
Great Profesor , test are pretty straightforward . If you read his slides and pay attention to class you should be fine . Take him !

Four tests, all noncumulative, based on lecture powerpoints. Learn the big concepts in class, the small details at home by reviewing the powerpoints, and you'll have a great time. Always an interesting lecture.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Clear grading criteria--TEST HEAVY

reviews.comment: This class is basically bio 112 just more in depth. Other than some papers to read the test material is 90%+ the ppt. Your grade comes from 4 tests that can be tricky with A&B and all-the-above choices. Criscione was ok but mostly read directly off the ppt. Sometimes he confused the class on a topic when someone asked. Not terrible but not great...

Dr. Criscione is straightforward. He tests directly from the slides. Study those repeatedly. He gave 6-8 extra credit points a couple of lectures because people stopped showing up. If you get those, plus the little help he gives you (he'll omit a question or two from time to time if nearly everyone missed it), and study the slides you'll be fine.
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--GRADED BY FEW THINGS--LECTURE HEAVY

reviews.comment: Tests straight from powerpoints. Tests 3,4 had a lot of material. Go to office hours, very helpful. Had EC. Lots of memorization. Lectures are dry. Monotone. No homework, not textbook needed
reviews.ratingTags: ACCESSIBLE OUTSIDE CLASS--TEST HEAVY--GRADED BY FEW THINGS

reviews.comment: Dr. Criscione is a very kind and straightforward man. He is not trying to trick you on his tests (there are 4 non-cumulative tests overall each equally weighted). All the material is straight from his slides which are posted. Study those hard and you're good. SI is super helpful especially if Bianca is still doing it. He did have some EC too.
